name: a date with the voice inside my head
source:
a date with the voice inside my head is a comedic and short dating sim made for NaNoRenO 2023!

Kiki may exist only in your head, but you love her all the same! Who'd need anything else? Surely not you. And now you get to go on a date with her!!!

Just don't think about reality and you'll be fine, right?

[From [url=https://higd3.itch.io/a-date-with-the-voice-in-my-head]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《a date with the voice inside my head》是一款为NaNoRenO2023制作的短篇喜剧恋爱模拟游戏！

Kiki或许只存在于你的脑海中，但你对她的爱丝毫不减！还需要别的什么呢？反正你不需要。现在，你终于能和她约会了！

只要不去想现实，一切就都没问题，对吧？

[摘自[url=https://higd3.itch.io/a-date-with-the-voice-in-my-head]itch.io[/url]]
